transcript.text: I have an urgent infection prevention concern. I personally reviewed the patient's pending respiratory panel, and it is positive for measles. Because measles requires airborne isolation, this bronchoscopy cannot be performed in Procedure Room 2 -- it must take place in AIIR 4. I should note that the laboratory interface has not yet posted this result to the procedural schedule, which is likely why it hasn't been flagged in the system yet.

transcript.text: I have an important respiratory therapy concern. My bedside assessment shows the patient will need noninvasive ventilation during the bronchoscopy. The approved setup for this is the HEPA NIV adapter, which I need to bring and test before the procedure. This requirement is in respiratory therapy's bedside assessment but hasn't been entered into the procedural booking, so it may not be on everyone's radar yet. This is relevant to the location decision because the NIV setup with the HEPA adapter needs to be tested in whichever room we choose before the procedure begins.
